useWhen: After major releases to assess impact
When metrics seem off or declining

workflow.description: Collect data across all health dimensions: user engagement, product-market fit, technical health, business health, competitive position
Rate each dimension: Green (healthy), Yellow (watch), Red (critical)
Document risks with likelihood, impact, and potential mitigation
For each issue identified, recommend specific actions to address

examples.input: Conduct a monthly product health check
examples.output: Health check report with status ratings, risks identified, and recommended actions for each dimension
examples.context: Regular monthly assessment of product performance

examples.input: Our retention dropped 20% - help assess product health
examples.output: Focused health assessment identifying root causes and recommended fixes for retention decline
